data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fini was a goddess of the end or conclusion of things. She was often depicted as a woman holding a torch or a key, symbolizing the end of a cycle and the beginning of a new one. The name Fini carries the meaning “End, conclusion” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fini usually hope their child will grow to embody end, conclusion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
